sn22.37:1.3: Then the Venerable Ānanda approached the Blessed One…. The Blessed One then said to the Venerable Ānanda as he was sitting to one side:
sn22.37:2.1: “If, Ānanda, they were to ask you:
sn22.37:2.2: ‘Friend Ānanda, what are the things of which an arising is discerned, a vanishing is discerned, an alteration of that which stands is discerned?’—
sn22.37:2.3: being asked thus, how would you answer?”
sn22.37:2.4: “Venerable sir, if they were to ask me this,
sn22.37:2.7: ‘Friends, with form an arising is discerned, a vanishing is discerned, an alteration of that which stands is discerned.
sn22.37:2.11: consciousness an arising is discerned, a vanishing is discerned, an alteration of that which stands is discerned.
sn22.37:2.12: These, friends, are the things of which an arising is discerned, a vanishing is discerned, an alteration of that which stands is discerned.’
sn22.37:2.13: Being asked thus, venerable sir, I would answer in such a way.”
sn22.37:3.2: With form, Ānanda, an arising is discerned, a vanishing is discerned, an alteration of that which stands is discerned.
sn22.37:3.6: consciousness an arising is discerned, a vanishing is discerned, an alteration of that which stands is discerned.
sn22.37:3.7: These, Ānanda, are the things of which an arising is discerned, a vanishing is discerned, an alteration of that which stands is discerned.
sn22.37:3.8: Being asked thus, Ānanda, you should answer in such a way.”
